# Flappy Bird Clone With Bat

> Owner: John Hewitt  ·  Created: 2026-09-24

## Begin (raw)
<!-- 3-minute brain dump. Do not edit or reinterpret. -->
Just a flappy bird clone with a bat instead of a bird.

## Refine (scope)
- **Goal**: A fully playable single-player Flappy Bird clone, with a bat instead of a bird, set in a simple cave theme.
- **In / Out of scope**: In: gravity/flap movement, scrolling obstacles, collision detection, scoring, game over/restart, keyboard controls, simple cave-themed art. Out: multiplayer, mobile/touch controls, leaderboards/online features (unless added later as new intents).
- **Definition of Done**: Player can open the page, press a key to flap the bat, navigate through scrolling obstacles in a cave setting, see score increase, die on collision, and restart — fully playable start to finish.
- **Constraints**: Keyboard-only controls. Vanilla JS + Canvas, no framework/build step (per project CONTEXT.md).
- **Risks**: (none noted)
- **Resources**: Simple art — pull free/CC0 art assets or create simple placeholder art (shapes/sprites) as needed.
- **Dependencies**: (none)
